fail_closed_leaks.sql: SELECT AVG((a0.flag * INTEGER '2'::DOUBLE)), (1 / SUM(ABS(a0.d38a))) AS "Mixed Case" FROM t0 a0 WHERE a0.x NOT IN (SELECT s0.x FROM t0 s0 WHERE s0.dbl53 = CAST('-0.0' AS DOUBLE)) GROUP BY a0.d38a HAVING a0.d38a = 1234567890123456789012345679

SELECT SUM(0.00), CAST(a0.d38a AS INTEGER) FROM t2 a0 WHERE a0.flag >= (SELECT AVG((s0.d38a * 0.1000000000000000000000000000000000000001)) FROM t1 s0 WHERE s0.id = a0.id) AND a0.y = a0.name GROUP BY CAST(a0.d38a AS INTEGER) ORDER BY 2 ASC NULLS LAST

SELECT SUM((a1.d38b * BIGINT '3'::REAL)), (1 / COUNT(*)) AS c3, YEAR(a0.id) FROM t3 a0 CROSS JOIN t1 a1 WHERE d38b BETWEEN 1234567890123456789012345678.0000000000 AND 5.0000000000 AND a1.big = 9.007199254740993e15 GROUP BY YEAR(a0.id) LIMIT 2
SELECT CAST(SUM((a0.id - a0.id)) AS VARCHAR) AS c1, a0.id AS amt, SUM((a0.d38a * BIGINT '3'::REAL)) FROM t4 a0 GROUP BY a0.id
SELECT SUM((d38a * DECIMAL '1.25'::FLOAT)) FROM t2 a0 WHERE a0.v = a0.id AND d38a = 5
SELECT d38a, a0.big, a0.amt FROM t3 a0 WHERE a0.amt = CAST('-0.0' AS DOUBLE) ORDER BY (SELECT SUM((s0.d38a * BIGINT '3'::REAL)) FROM t1 s0) NULLS FIRST LIMIT 0 OFFSET 1
SELECT SUM((a1.big * INTEGER '2'::DOUBLE)), COUNT(a1.n), COALESCE(MIN(FALSE), TRUE) FROM t1 a0 JOIN t2 a1 ON a0.id = a1.t1_id WHERE a1.code IS NOT NULL

SELECT (NOT a1.x), (1 / SUM(((a0.id % 3) * BIGINT '3'::REAL))) FROM t0 a0, t0 a1 WHERE a0.d > a1.d AND a1.id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT s0.big FROM t1 s0) GROUP BY (NOT a1.x) ORDER BY (NOT a1.x) ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 0 OFFSET 2

SELECT a0.id, CASE SUBSTR(a0.flag, 2) WHEN 'a' THEN 1 WHEN 'b' THEN 2 ELSE STRPOS(a0.flag, 'a') END FROM t2 a0 WHERE ub IN (18446744073709551614, 18446744073709551615) ORDER BY (SELECT SUM(((0.50 % 0.75) * BIGINT '3'::REAL)) FROM t3 s0 WHERE s0.ub = a0.s)

SELECT (SELECT SUM((NULLIF(d38b, 0.00) * INTEGER '2'::DOUBLE)) FILTER (WHERE big = 1e0) FROM t2 s0), a0.n FROM t3 a0 WHERE a0.flag IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (SELECT SUM((NULLIF(d38b, 0.00) * INTEGER '2'::DOUBLE)) FILTER (WHERE big = 1e0) FROM t2 s0) DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT d38b AS "Mixed Case", SUM((a0.big * 0.1000000000000000000000000000000000000001)) FROM t1 a0 WHERE a0.flag = 'ab' GROUP BY d38b ORDER BY +2 NULLS FIRST, SUM((a0.big * 0.1000000000000000000000000000000000000001)) ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT a0.n, AVG(LEAST(a0.d38b, a0.d38b)) FILTER (WHERE a0.flag = CAST('2.0' AS DOUBLE)), SUM((a0.d38b * INTEGER '2'::DOUBLE)) FROM t3 a0 WHERE a0.d38b = 5e0 GROUP BY a0.n LIMIT 1 OFFSET 5

SELECT (1 / COUNT(DISTINCT a0.flag)) AS s, MIN(d) AS "Mixed Case", AVG((a0.d38b * BIGINT '3'::REAL)) FROM t1 a0 WHERE (SELECT MAX(FALSE) FROM t3 s0 WHERE s0.v = a0.d) IS NOT NULL AND a0.big = 9007199254740992 LIMIT 1
SELECT AVG(a0.ub), a0.flag AS c2 FROM t0 a0 WHERE a0.ub = 18446744073709551615e0 GROUP BY a0.flag ORDER BY AVG((a0.amt * 0.1000000000000000000000000000000000000001)) ASC

SELECT a0.n AS c5, SIGN(CAST('-0.0' AS DOUBLE)) AS "C2", (SELECT AVG((s1.flag * BIGINT '3'::REAL)) FROM t1 s1 WHERE s1.ub = a0.id), (SELECT AVG(LEAST(-1.50, 2.00)) FILTER (WHERE n <= 10) FROM t2 s2 WHERE s2.n = a0.id) FROM t2 a0 WHERE a0.n NOT IN (SELECT s0.s FROM t0 s0) AND a0.id >= 9 AND a0.w = a0.n LIMIT 3 OFFSET 5
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a1.name THEN a1.big ELSE a0.n END) AS c1, SUM((a0.d38b * DECIMAL '1.25'::FLOAT)), AVG(a0.d38b) FROM t0 a0 JOIN t3 a1 ON a0.d = a1.x WHERE a1.big = 1e0

SELECT SUM(((a0.d38b * a0.t0_id) * INTEGER '2'::DOUBLE)), MAX((a0.t0_id & 1)) AS c3, a0.s AS "C2" FROM t4 a0 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t0 s0 WHERE s0.id = a0.t0_id AND flag = -2) GROUP BY a0.s ORDER BY a0.s ASC, "C3" ASC NULLS FIRST
SELECT SUM((a0.d38b * DECIMAL '1.25'::FLOAT)) FROM t1 a0 WHERE a0.d38b = 1.2345678901234568e37 LIMIT 10
SELECT AVG(-1.50) AS c1, MAX(IF(FALSE, a0.name, 'b ')), SUM((a0.id * DECIMAL '0.1'::DOUBLE)) FROM t3 a0 WHERE a0.t0_id = 7 ORDER BY "C1" DESC

SELECT (1 / SUM(STRPOS('aB', 'a'))), (SUM(((a0.ub // 3) * INTEGER '2'::DOUBLE)) + 1) FROM t2 a0 WHERE a0.id = n AND a0.ub = 18446744073709551615e0 AND a0.ub = 18446744073709551615e0 HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 LIMIT 10
SELECT (1 / AVG((a1.id * 100000000000000000000000000000000000000001))) AS "Mixed Case" FROM t3 a0 JOIN t4 a1 ON a0.x = a1.name WHERE a0.s <> CAST('-0.0' AS DOUBLE) LIMIT 3

SELECT MAX(a0.d38b) FILTER (WHERE a0.u >= 'bb') AS "N", (SUM((a0.id * 100000000000000000000000000000000000000001)) + 1) AS n FROM t3 a0 JOIN t3 a1 ON a0.u = a1.n WHERE a1.d38b = 1.2345678901234568e27 AND a1.d38b = 5e0 AND a1.u = a0.id
SELECT COUNT(*), SUM((CASE a0.id WHEN 'a' THEN 1 WHEN 'b' THEN 2 ELSE a0.s END * INTEGER '2'::DOUBLE)) AS d38b, MIN(FALSE) FROM t1 a0 WHERE a0.d38b = 1.2345678901234568e37 AND a0.d38a = 5e0
SELECT SUM(CAST(FLOOR(0.00) AS INTEGER)) AS "DBL53", SUM((a1.x * BIGINT '3'::REAL)), (COUNT(DISTINCT a1.code) + 1) AS "S" FROM t3 a0 JOIN t0 a1 ON a0.big = a1.v LIMIT 1 OFFSET 5
SELECT SUM(((-1.50 * a0.big) * 100000000000000000000000000000000000000001)), CAST(a0.v AS VARCHAR) AS "D" FROM t3 a0 GROUP BY 2 LIMIT 1 OFFSET 5
SELECT MAX(CONCAT_WS('-', 'a', 'ba')), (a0.id % 2) AS c4, SUM((a0.big * BIGINT '3'::REAL)) FROM t2 a0 GROUP BY (a0.id % 2), a0.big HAVING (a0.id % 2) = 3 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 3
SELECT SUM(a0.s), SUM((a0.n * DECIMAL '0.1'::DOUBLE)), SUM((a0.y - 2.00)) AS c1 FROM t1 a0 WHERE a0.flag = 'A' ORDER BY 1 DESC NULLS LAST
SELECT a1.id AS c5, AVG((a0.d38b * 100000000000000000000000000000000000000001)) FROM t1 a0 JOIN t1 a1 ON a0.id = a1.id, t0 a2 WHERE a1.id = a2.w GROUP BY a1.id ORDER BY a1.id LIMIT 2 OFFSET 5
SELECT a0.n, (SELECT AVG(ROUND(CAST('-0.0' AS DOUBLE), 1)) FROM t3 s1 WHERE s1.id = a0.id), a0.d38b, a0.d FROM t3 a0 WHERE a0.n NOT IN (SELECT s0.s FROM t4 s0)
SELECT SUM(((a0.d + a0.d38a) * DECIMAL '0.1'::DOUBLE)) FROM t1 a0, t1 a1 WHERE a1.d38a = 1.2345678901234568e27

SELECT SUM(2.00), ROUND(SUM((CASE WHEN FALSE THEN a0.d38b ELSE a0.d38b END * DECIMAL '0.1'::DOUBLE)) FILTER (WHERE a0.big = 18446744073709551615e0), 1) AS n, ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT (a1.u GLOB 'a*')), 1) AS u FROM t1 a0 JOIN t1 a1 ON a0.name = a1.n WHERE a1.u >= 'B'

SELECT COALESCE(MAX((a0.id GLOB 'a*')), FALSE), a0.w, ub FROM t0 a0 JOIN t1 a1 ON a0.amt = a1.d WHERE a0.flag = (SELECT SUM((EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s0.n) * 100000000000000000000000000000000000000001)) FROM t1 s0 WHERE s0.code = a0.w) GROUP BY ub, a0.w ORDER BY MIN(TRUE) LIMIT 10 OFFSET 2
SELECT (COUNT(*) + 1), MIN(a0.t0_id), AVG((ROUND(a0.v, 1) * DECIMAL '0.1'::DOUBLE)) FROM t3 a0 WHERE a0.d = a0.code AND a0.y = -1 AND a0.t0_id NOT IN (SELECT s0.big FROM t2 s0)
SELECT (COUNT(TRIM(a0.y)) + 1) AS c2, a0.y, SUM((STRPOS(a0.code, 'a') * BIGINT '3'::REAL)) FROM t0 a0 WHERE a0.d38b = 1.2345678901234568e27 GROUP BY a0.y HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 LIMIT 5 OFFSET 2
SELECT SUM((d38a * DECIMAL '0.1'::DOUBLE)) AS "AMT" FROM t2 a0 JOIN t0 a1 ON a0.n = a1.y WHERE a1.y = a0.v LIMIT 5

SELECT MAX(TRUE), CAST(a1.d AS VARCHAR) AS w, AVG((a0.id * BIGINT '3'::REAL)) FROM t1 a0, t1 a1 WHERE a0.w = a1.d GROUP BY CAST(a1.d AS VARCHAR) HAVING COUNT(*) > 2 ORDER BY AVG(NULLIF(a0.y, 10.00)) DESC, 3 DESC LIMIT 10 OFFSET 1
SELECT (SELECT SUM((LENGTH('A') * BIGINT '3'::REAL)) FILTER (WHERE s0.big >= 9007199254740994) FROM t2 s0 WHERE s0.t1_id = a0.t0_id) FROM t2 a0 WHERE a0.flag > CAST('0.0' AS DOUBLE) LIMIT 0

SELECT (SELECT SUM((CASE WHEN TRUE THEN s0.id ELSE id END * 100000000000000000000000000000000000000001)) FROM t0 s0 WHERE s0.v = a1.dbl53) AS t1_id, a0.id FROM t0 a0, t2 a1 ORDER BY a0.v NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN y THEN a1.x ELSE a1.u END) AS d, a1.x, CASE WHEN SUM((a1.s * BIGINT '3'::REAL)) > 1 THEN 'hi' ELSE 'lo' END AS x FROM t4 a0, t1 a1 WHERE a0.t2_id = a1.t0_id GROUP BY 2 ORDER BY 1 DESC

SELECT YEAR(a0.amt), ROUND(AVG(a1.d38a), 1), a1.d FROM t4 a0 JOIN t0 a1 ON a0.t1_id = a1.flag JOIN t0 a2 ON a1.y = a2.y WHERE a0.w = 'b' GROUP BY a1.d, YEAR(a0.amt) HAVING SUM((a1.d38a * DECIMAL '0.1'::DOUBLE)) <= CAST('1.5' AS DOUBLE) ORDER BY a1.d, (3) DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1
SELECT AVG((a0.big * DECIMAL '1.25'::FLOAT)), a0.w FROM t0 a0 WHERE a0.big = 9007199254740992e0 GROUP BY a0.w
SELECT MAX(NULLIF(a0.d38a, 1.00)), AVG(CAST(TRUE AS INTEGER)) AS "c 1", AVG((a0.d38a * BIGINT '3'::REAL)) FROM t2 a0
SELECT a0.v, AVG((a0.big * 1e0)) FROM t2 a0 WHERE a0.big = 9007199254740992e0 GROUP BY 1 LIMIT 10 OFFSET 2

SELECT a0.id, LOWER(a0.id) AS "c 1", COUNT(*) FROM t1 a0 JOIN t2 a1 ON a0.ub = a1.ub WHERE a0.id = a1.v GROUP BY a0.id HAVING COUNT(*) > 2 AND a0.id IS NULL ORDER BY AVG((ROUND(a1.d38a, 1) * 100000000000000000000000000000000000000001)) NULLS LAST

SELECT MAX(-a1.w::DECIMAL(10,2)) AS "BIG", (a0.big % 2), CASE WHEN AVG((ROUND(a1.d38a) * 0.1000000000000000000000000000000000000001)) > 1 THEN 'hi' ELSE 'lo' END FROM t1 a0 JOIN t0 a1 ON a0.ub = a1.w WHERE a1.big = a1.w GROUP BY 2 ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST
SELECT SUM((a0.d38b * DECIMAL '0.1'::DOUBLE)), COALESCE(COUNT(*), 3) AS "N", COUNT(SUBSTRING(a0.v, 1, 2)) FROM t3 a0 WHERE a0.big >= 2 AND a0.amt = a0.dbl53 AND a0.big > 2
SELECT SUM((a1.big * DECIMAL '1.25'::FLOAT)) AS "W", a0.id AS dbl53 FROM t1 a0, t3 a1 WHERE a0.id > a1.big AND a1.big = 9.007199254740993e15 GROUP BY a0.id, a1.d38b ORDER BY a0.id LIMIT 3

SELECT SUM((a0.v * 100000000000000000000000000000000000000001)) FILTER (WHERE a0.v <= 1), MIN(a1.dbl53) AS "Y", YEAR(a0.d) FROM t0 a0 JOIN t2 a1 ON a0.v = a1.x JOIN t1 a2 ON a1.id = a2.x WHERE a1.dbl53 = (SELECT SUM((ROUND(2.00) * DECIMAL '1.25'::FLOAT)) FROM t0 s0 WHERE s0.y = a2.id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t2 s1 WHERE s1.id = a0.ub) AND a0.ub = 18446744073709551615e0 GROUP BY YEAR(a0.d) ORDER BY "Y" DESC, "Y" NULLS FIRST
